whyItMatters: Sudo grants passwordless execution (NOPASSWDs*:), so compromise of the account silently escalates.
actions: Restrict the grant with exact-command scoping to exact binaries, never ALL.
Prefer requiring a password where automation allows.
Re-run the scan and confirm no broad NOPASSWD remains.
verification: Rescan shows no broad NOPASSWD, and sudo -l audits minimal.
